finding: Large entry stall is localized to first RenderingServer pre/post draw bracket, not section setup. Driver/resource/pipeline contributor remains unisolated; these signals are not a GPU hardware timer.
decision: No prewarm/loading delay added: it would relocate first-submit cost into startup without evidence of removing it. All constructor and first-render costs retained in evidence; cold hitch remains unresolved.

measurement_definitions.total_frame_interval_ms: Wall-clock interval between native process callbacks; includes rendering/presentation/scheduling effects. p50/p95/p99/worst reported separately for warm and first3seconds.
measurement_definitions.warm_process_ms_median: Godot Performance.TIME_PROCESS monitor multiplied by1000. CPU-side process-time diagnostic, not total frame interval or input latency. Sampled monitor values update less often than callbacks.
measurement_definitions.cold: Fresh game process entry, not OS/driver cache cold boot.
